items.q: Find the area of a rectangle with sides 8 and x + 3.
hints: Area of a rectangle = length x width.

items.q: Find the circumference of a circle of radius r.
hints: Recall the circumference formula in terms of the radius.

items.q: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 8 and 12 and height 5.
Find the area of a triangle with base 14 and height 9.
hints: Use area = (1/2) x base x height.

items.q: Find the area of a semicircle of radius 6.
hints: A semicircle's area is half the area of a full circle: (1/2)πr^2.

items.q: Find the perimeter of a square of side 3x.
hints: A square's perimeter is 4 times the side length.

items.q: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length (x+5) and width 3, when x = 7.
hints: Substitute x into the length first, then use perimeter = 2(length + width).

items.q: An L-shape is made from rectangles 8 by 3 and 5 by 2. Find the total area.
hints: Split the L-shape into two rectangles and add their areas.

items.q: A circle of radius 7 sits inside a square of side 14. Find the shaded area outside the circle.
hints: Subtract the circle's area from the square's area.

items.q: Find the area of a semicircle of radius 6.
hints: A semicircle's area is half the area of a full circle: (1/2)πr^2.

items.q: A shape is made from a 10 by 4 rectangle and a 3 by 6 rectangle. Find the total area.
hints: Add the areas of the two rectangles together.

items.q: A 12 by 9 rectangle has a 4 by 3 rectangle removed. Find the remaining area.
hints: Subtract the removed rectangle's area from the whole rectangle's area.

items.q: Two rectangles 7 by 5 and 2 by 9 are joined without overlap. Find the total area.
hints: Add the areas of the two rectangles together.
